ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (7) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Воспитание» (vospitaniye) is 'upbringing', kept distinct from «образование» (obrazovaniye, 'education') and «обучение» (obucheniye, 'instruction'), so that Mazzini's play on «питание» (pitaniye, 'nourishing') stays visible. «Иосиф Мадзини» is given as Giuseppe Mazzini.
